summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The npm package's preinstall script setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a co-shipped 727 KB file named math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (Bun-CJS wrapper, string-array rotation function, character-map decoder, mixed number/string constant tables) and is not human-reviewable. setup.mjs itself uses the same _0x-style obfuscated identifiers. The package advertises itself as a prebuilt CLI distribution shipping bin/umadev; that purpose does not require fetching a second runtime and executing an obfuscated JS blob at install time. The Bun download is used specifically to execute payload code that the standard Node-based install path would not run, and the payload's actual behavior on the installer's machine cannot be determined from its contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
